claims.evidence: Witness report shows wooden pallets with stamps/labels and printed markings, but no readable HT/IPPC or origin/export stamp details were captured.

risks.risk: Unknown pallet size/dimensions, which affects usability and how many can be loaded per shipment
risks.proof: A photo with a tape measure showing length/width/height of at least one pallet (top view + side view).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mixed/unknown size pallets (worst-case for matching and loading), with no guarantee of standard fit.

risks.risk: Condition uncertainty: broken boards, missing nails, cracks, or unsafe pallets for load-bearing
risks.proof: Close-up shots of multiple pallets showing all corners and underside, plus a clip of a pallet being lifted/checked for wobble or broken stringers.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn/dirty pallets with potential defects (worst-case: not suitable for heavy loads).

risks.risk: Heat-treatment/export compliance unknown (HT/IPPC): absence or unreadability of required markings can make them unusable for export or regulated use
risks.proof: Clear, readable close-ups of any stamps/labels on the wood (especially the HT/IPPC mark) with the stamp in focus.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-certified/unknown treatment pallets (worst-case: only for non-regulated internal use).

risks.risk: Quantity uncertainty (how many pallets are included), which directly impacts per-unit value
risks.proof: A wide shot showing the full lot with a count reference (e.g., numbered stacks) or a clip panning across the entire stack area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming the lot count is not confirmed and may be smaller than expected.

risks.risk: Moisture/infestation/odor risk (mold, pests) not verifiable from the current angles
risks.proof: A close-up of wood surfaces for mold/pest signs plus a clip showing the pallets being inspected (including smell/handling note by seller).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially contaminated/wet pallets (worst-case: requires cleaning/drying before use).

risks.risk: Readiness for delivery/loading: whether pallets are banded/strapped, and whether they are stable for transport
risks.proof: A clip showing how the pallets are stacked and whether they are strapped/banded, and how they will be loaded onto a truck.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed ready for loading (worst-case: extra handling needed).

proof_requests: Provide exact pallet dimensions (L/W/H) with a tape measure on at least one pallet.
Show clear close-ups of any stamps/labels, especially HT/IPPC markings, with the text readable.
Confirm the total number of pallets in the lot (wide shot with count or numbered stacks).
Upload close-ups of corners/underside for multiple pallets showing any broken boards, cracks, missing nails, or loose stringers.
Show whether pallets are banded/strapped and demonstrate loading readiness (short loading clip).
Confirm moisture condition and any infestation/odor; provide inspection photos of wood surfaces.
response.reason: The witness confirms they are wooden pallets, but key pricing drivers (standard size, condition defects, HT/IPPC compliance, and exact quantity) are not verifiable from the provided shots. Without those, a worst-case price would be too speculative.
